Imported areas are community mapping, no.en: Imported areas are community mapping, not surveyed boundaries. Saved areas work offline.
Imported areas are community mapping, no.ko: 가져온 영역은 커뮤니티 지도이며 측량된 경계가 아닙니다. 저장한 영역은 오프라인에서도 사용할 수 있습니다.
Imported areas are community mapping, no.ja: 読み込んだエリアは共同編集の地図であり、測量済みの境界ではありません。保存済みのエリアはオフラインで使えます。
Imported areas are community mapping, no.zh-Hans: 导入区域来自社区地图，并非测量边界。已保存区域可离线使用。
Imported areas are community mapping, no.zh-Hant: 匯入區域來自社群地圖，並非測量邊界。已儲存區域可離線使用。
Imported areas are community mapping, no.es: Las zonas importadas proceden de mapas comunitarios, no de límites topográficos. Las zonas guardadas funcionan sin conexión.
Imported areas are community mapping, no.pt-BR: As áreas importadas vêm de mapas comunitários, não de limites topográficos. As áreas salvas funcionam offline.
Imported areas are community mapping, no.de: Importierte Flächen stammen aus Gemeinschaftskarten, nicht aus Vermessungen. Gespeicherte Flächen funktionieren offline.
Imported areas are community mapping, no.fr: Les zones importées proviennent de cartes communautaires, pas de relevés topographiques. Les zones enregistrées fonctionnent hors ligne.
Imported areas are community mapping, no.it: Le aree importate provengono da mappe della comunità, non da rilievi. Le aree salvate funzionano offline.
Imported areas are community mapping, no.th: พื้นที่นำเข้ามาจากแผนที่ชุมชน ไม่ใช่ขอบเขตที่สำรวจแล้ว พื้นที่ที่บันทึกใช้แบบออฟไลน์ได้
Imported areas are community mapping, no.vi: Khu vực nhập từ bản đồ cộng đồng, không phải ranh giới đã đo đạc. Khu vực đã lưu dùng được ngoại tuyến.

Map import failed. Your saved areas are.ja: 地図を読み込めませんでした。保存済みのエリアは引き続き利用できます。
Map import failed. Your saved areas are.zh-Hans: 地图导入失败。已保存区域仍可使用。
Map import failed. Your saved areas are.zh-Hant: 地圖匯入失敗。已儲存區域仍可使用。
Map import failed. Your saved areas are.es: No se pudo importar el mapa. Tus zonas guardadas siguen disponibles.
Map import failed. Your saved areas are.pt-BR: Falha ao importar o mapa. Suas áreas salvas continuam disponíveis.
Map import failed. Your saved areas are.de: Kartenimport fehlgeschlagen. Gespeicherte Flächen bleiben verfügbar.
Map import failed. Your saved areas are.fr: Échec de l’importation. Vos zones enregistrées restent disponibles.
Map import failed. Your saved areas are.it: Importazione non riuscita. Le aree salvate restano disponibili.
Map import failed. Your saved areas are.th: นำเข้าแผนที่ไม่สำเร็จ พื้นที่ที่บันทึกยังใช้งานได้
Map import failed. Your saved areas are.vi: Nhập bản đồ thất bại. Khu vực đã lưu vẫn khả dụng.

No complete mapped areas were found here.es: No se encontraron zonas completas aquí.
No complete mapped areas were found here.pt-BR: Nenhuma área completa foi encontrada aqui.

Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.en: Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an area to replace its outline.
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.ko: 탭하여 다각형 꼭짓점을 추가하세요. 영역을 선택하면 윤곽을 바꿀 수 있습니다.
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.ja: タップして多角形の頂点を追加します。輪郭を変更するにはエリアを選びます。
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.zh-Hans: 点按添加多边形顶点。选择区域可替换轮廓。
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.zh-Hant: 點一下加入多邊形頂點。選擇區域可替換輪廓。
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.es: Toca para añadir vértices. Selecciona una zona para reemplazar su contorno.
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.pt-BR: Toque para adicionar vértices. Selecione uma área para substituir seu contorno.
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.de: Tippen fügt Eckpunkte hinzu. Eine Fläche auswählen, um ihren Umriss zu ersetzen.
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.fr: Touchez pour ajouter des sommets. Sélectionnez une zone pour remplacer son contour.
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.it: Tocca per aggiungere vertici. Seleziona un’area per sostituirne il contorno.
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.th: แตะเพื่อเพิ่มจุดยอดรูปหลายเหลี่ยม เลือกพื้นที่เพื่อเปลี่ยนเส้นขอบ
Tap to add polygon vertices. Select an a.vi: Chạm để thêm đỉnh đa giác. Chọn khu vực để thay đường viền.

Add carry or total and both variability.en: Add carry or total and both variability values in My Bag to compare aims.
Add carry or total and both variability.ko: 조준점을 비교하려면 내 가방에 캐리 또는 총 거리와 두 변동성 값을 입력하세요.
Add carry or total and both variability.ja: 狙いを比較するには、マイバッグでキャリーまたは総距離と両方向のばらつきを入力してください。
Add carry or total and both variability.zh-Hans: 在我的球包中添加飞行或总距离及两个离散值以比较瞄准点。
Add carry or total and both variability.zh-Hant: 在我的球袋中加入飛行或總距離及兩個離散值以比較瞄準點。
Add carry or total and both variability.es: Añade carry o distancia total y ambas variabilidades en Mi bolsa para comparar objetivos.
Add carry or total and both variability.pt-BR: Adicione carry ou distância total e ambas as variabilidades em Minha bolsa para comparar miras.
Add carry or total and both variability.de: Für Zielvergleiche Carry oder Gesamtdistanz und beide Streuungen unter Meine Tasche eintragen.
Add carry or total and both variability.fr: Ajoutez le carry ou la distance totale et les deux dispersions dans Mon sac pour comparer les visées.
Add carry or total and both variability.it: Aggiungi carry o distanza totale e le due variabilità in La mia sacca per confrontare le mire.
Add carry or total and both variability.th: เพิ่มระยะลอยหรือระยะรวมและค่าความแปรปรวนทั้งสองในถุงกอล์ฟของฉันเพื่อเทียบจุดเล็ง
Add carry or total and both variability.vi: Thêm khoảng bay hoặc tổng khoảng cách và hai độ phân tán trong Túi gậy để so sánh điểm ngắm.

Aim search balances target error, variab.en: Aim search balances target error, variability and supplied hazard areas. Strategy weights are preferences, not predicted scores.
Aim search balances target error, variab.ko: 조준 검색은 목표 오차, 변동성과 입력된 해저드 영역을 고려합니다. 전략 가중치는 선호도이며 예상 스코어가 아닙니다.
Aim search balances target error, variab.ja: 狙いの検索は目標とのずれ、ばらつき、入力済みのハザードを考慮します。戦略の重みは好みであり、予測スコアではありません。
Aim search balances target error, variab.zh-Hans: 瞄准搜索综合目标误差、离散度和提供的障碍区。策略权重代表偏好，并非预测杆数。
Aim search balances target error, variab.zh-Hant: 瞄準搜尋綜合目標誤差、離散度和提供的障礙區。策略權重代表偏好，並非預測桿數。
Aim search balances target error, variab.es: La búsqueda equilibra error, variabilidad y obstáculos registrados. Los pesos reflejan preferencias, no resultados previstos.
Aim search balances target error, variab.pt-BR: A busca equilibra erro, variabilidade e obstáculos informados. Os pesos são preferências, não pontuações previstas.
Aim search balances target error, variab.de: Die Zielsuche berücksichtigt Zielabweichung, Streuung und erfasste Hindernisse. Gewichte sind Präferenzen, keine Schlagprognosen.
Aim search balances target error, variab.fr: La recherche équilibre l’écart, la dispersion et les obstacles fournis. Les poids expriment des préférences, pas des scores prédits.
Aim search balances target error, variab.it: La ricerca bilancia errore, variabilità e ostacoli inseriti. I pesi esprimono preferenze, non punteggi previsti.
Aim search balances target error, variab.th: การค้นหาจุดเล็งคำนึงถึงความคลาดเคลื่อน ความแปรปรวน และพื้นที่อุปสรรค น้ำหนักกลยุทธ์เป็นความชอบ ไม่ใช่คะแนนคาดการณ์
Aim search balances target error, variab.vi: Tìm điểm ngắm cân bằng sai lệch, độ phân tán và vùng chướng ngại đã nhập. Trọng số thể hiện ưu tiên, không dự đoán điểm.

Enter expected landing shifts in your di.en: Enter expected landing shifts in your distance unit. These assumptions are not a wind or elevation measurement.
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.ko: 선택한 거리 단위로 예상 착지 이동량을 입력하세요. 이는 가정이며 바람이나 고도 측정값이 아닙니다.
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.ja: 設定した距離単位で予想着地点のずれを入力します。これは仮定であり、風や高低差の測定値ではありません。
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.zh-Hans: 用所选距离单位输入预计落点偏移。这是假设，不是风或高度测量。
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.zh-Hant: 用所選距離單位輸入預計落點偏移。這是假設，不是風或高度測量。
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.es: Introduce desplazamientos previstos en tu unidad de distancia. Son supuestos, no medidas del viento ni del desnivel.
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.pt-BR: Insira os desvios esperados na sua unidade de distância. São suposições, não medições de vento ou elevação.
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.de: Erwartete Landeverlagerungen in der gewählten Distanzeinheit eingeben. Dies sind Annahmen, keine Wind- oder Höhenmessungen.
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.fr: Saisissez les déplacements attendus dans votre unité de distance. Ce sont des hypothèses, pas des mesures de vent ou d’altitude.
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.it: Inserisci gli spostamenti attesi nell’unità scelta. Sono ipotesi, non misure di vento o dislivello.
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.th: ป้อนระยะเลื่อนจุดตกตามหน่วยระยะของคุณ ค่านี้เป็นสมมติฐาน ไม่ใช่การวัดลมหรือความสูง
Enter expected landing shifts in your di.vi: Nhập độ dịch chuyển điểm rơi theo đơn vị khoảng cách của bạn. Đây là giả định, không phải số đo gió hay độ cao.

Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.en: Hazard risk is conditional on your entered dispersion and mapped boundaries. Missing geometry means unavailable risk, not zero risk.
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.ko: 해저드 위험은 입력한 분산과 지도 경계에 따른 값입니다. 지형 정보가 없으면 위험을 알 수 없으며 0이 아닙니다.
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.ja: ハザードリスクは入力した分散と地図の境界が条件です。地形データがない場合は不明であり、ゼロではありません。
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.zh-Hans: 障碍风险取决于输入的离散度和地图边界。缺少几何数据表示风险不可用，而非零风险。
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.zh-Hant: 障礙風險取決於輸入的離散度和地圖邊界。缺少幾何資料表示風險不可用，而非零風險。
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.es: El riesgo depende de la dispersión y los límites introducidos. Sin geometría, el riesgo no está disponible; no es cero.
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.pt-BR: O risco depende da dispersão e dos limites informados. Sem geometria, o risco está indisponível, não é zero.
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.de: Das Risiko gilt nur für eingegebene Streuungen und Kartengrenzen. Fehlende Geometrie bedeutet unbekanntes Risiko, nicht null Risiko.
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.fr: Le risque dépend de la dispersion saisie et des limites cartographiées. Sans géométrie, il est indisponible, pas nul.
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.it: Il rischio dipende dalla dispersione inserita e dai confini. Senza geometria il rischio non è disponibile, non è zero.
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.th: ความเสี่ยงขึ้นกับการกระจายและขอบเขตที่ป้อน หากไม่มีรูปทรงจะไม่ทราบความเสี่ยง ไม่ใช่ความเสี่ยงศูนย์
Hazard risk is conditional on your enter.vi: Rủi ro phụ thuộc độ phân tán đã nhập và ranh giới bản đồ. Thiếu hình học là chưa rõ rủi ro, không phải không có rủi ro.

Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.en: Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied hazard areas.
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.ko: 해저드 영역이 없어 위험을 알 수 없습니다.
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.ja: ハザードのエリアがないためリスクは不明です。
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.zh-Hans: 未提供障碍区域，风险不可用。
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.zh-Hant: 未提供障礙區域，風險不可用。
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.es: Riesgo no disponible: faltan zonas de obstáculos.
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.pt-BR: Risco indisponível: nenhuma área de obstáculo informada.
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.de: Risiko nicht verfügbar: keine Hindernisflächen erfasst.
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.fr: Risque indisponible : aucune zone d’obstacle fournie.
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.it: Rischio non disponibile: nessuna area di ostacolo inserita.
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.th: ไม่ทราบความเสี่ยง เนื่องจากไม่มีพื้นที่อุปสรรค
Hazard risk unavailable — no supplied ha.vi: Chưa rõ rủi ro vì chưa có vùng chướng ngại.

Optional landing adjustments.th: การปรับจุดตกเพิ่มเติม
Optional landing adjustments.vi: Điều chỉnh điểm rơi tùy chọn

Shot type.th: ประเภทช็อต

Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.en: Tee shots use entered total distance; approaches use carry. Variability is assumed unchanged by roll and entered adjustments.
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.ko: 티샷에는 입력한 총 거리, 어프로치에는 캐리를 사용합니다. 구름과 입력한 보정이 변동성에 영향을 주지 않는다고 가정합니다.
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.ja: ティーショットは入力済みの総距離、アプローチはキャリーを使います。ランと入力補正によってばらつきは変わらないと仮定します。
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.zh-Hans: 开球使用输入的总距离，攻果岭使用飞行距离。假定滚动和输入调整不改变离散度。
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.zh-Hant: 開球使用輸入的總距離，攻果嶺使用飛行距離。假定滾動和輸入調整不改變離散度。
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.es: Las salidas usan la distancia total y las aproximaciones el carry. Se supone que la rodadura y los ajustes no cambian la variabilidad.
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.pt-BR: Saídas usam distância total; aproximações usam carry. Supõe-se que rolagem e ajustes não mudam a variabilidade.
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.de: Abschläge nutzen die Gesamtdistanz, Annäherungen den Carry. Roll und Korrekturen verändern die Streuung in diesem Modell nicht.
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.fr: Les départs utilisent la distance totale, les approches le carry. Le roulement et les corrections sont supposés ne pas changer la dispersion.
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.it: Le partenze usano la distanza totale, gli approcci il carry. Si presume che rotolamento e correzioni non modifichino la variabilità.
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.th: ช็อตทีใช้ระยะรวม แอปโพรชใช้ระยะลอย โดยสมมติว่าการกลิ้งและการปรับไม่เปลี่ยนความแปรปรวน
Tee shots use entered total distance; ap.vi: Phát bóng dùng tổng khoảng cách, tiếp cận dùng khoảng bay. Giả định độ phân tán không đổi do lăn và điều chỉnh.

Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.en: Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Caddie. Missing boundaries remain unavailable.
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.ko: 캐디는 입력된 다각형으로 해저드 위험을 계산합니다. 경계가 없으면 알 수 없습니다.
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.ja: キャディは入力された多角形でリスクを計算します。境界がない場所は不明のままです。
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.zh-Hans: 球童用已提供多边形计算风险。缺失边界仍不可用。
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.zh-Hant: 球僮用已提供多邊形計算風險。缺失邊界仍不可用。
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.es: El caddie calcula riesgos con los polígonos aportados. Los límites ausentes siguen sin estar disponibles.
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.pt-BR: O caddie usa polígonos informados para calcular riscos. Limites ausentes continuam indisponíveis.
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.de: Der Caddie berechnet Risiken anhand erfasster Polygone. Fehlende Grenzen bleiben unbekannt.
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.fr: Le caddie utilise les polygones fournis pour les risques. Les limites manquantes restent indisponibles.
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.it: Il caddie usa i poligoni inseriti per i rischi. I confini mancanti restano sconosciuti.
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.th: แคดดี้ใช้รูปหลายเหลี่ยมที่ป้อนคำนวณความเสี่ยง ขอบเขตที่ขาดยังไม่พร้อมใช้
Hazard risk uses supplied polygons in Ca.vi: Caddie dùng đa giác đã nhập để tính rủi ro. Ranh giới thiếu vẫn chưa rõ.
